title: Roll back to the node that caused a verification defect
narrative: When verification fails, Fangore wants structured attribution naming the repair target so the graph rolls back to that layer instead of restarting from scratch. Accepts WalkingLabs P08 guidance[^wl-p08-rollback].
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/select_produce.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
